bio_am: Կ. Պոլսեցի ահաբեկիչ, Սայիտ Հալիմ փաշայի (1921) եւ Ճեմալ Ազմիի ու Պեհաէտտին Շաքիրի (1922) ահաբեկիչը։ Մահացած է 1973-ին։
bio_en: Arshavir Shirakian was born and raised in Constantinople in a house that served as a meeting place for ARF intellectuals, who soon entrusted the youth with moving arms and gathering news. During the war he rendered valuable services to fugitive intellectuals, and in the Armistice period he kept watch on the informer Vahe Ihsan, whom he shot in 1920; after two months in hiding he escaped with a Swiss passport, was jailed in Tiflis's Metekh prison and broke out. Travelling as 'Arsil Sisak', he assassinated the former grand vizier Said Halim Pasha in Rome on 5 December 1921, and in Berlin on 17 April 1922, with Aram Yerkanian, killed Jemal Azmi and Behaeddin Shakir, organisers of the Genocide. He emigrated to the USA in early 1923, published his memoir 'The Legacy' ('Ktakn er nahatakneroun'), and died in 1973.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Death year: tributes of April 1973 (Karo Sasuni #114; Alik 15 April 1973).
